agent_rules: THROTTLE means slow down; ESCALATE means stop and hand the decision to a human.
An ALLOW covers one action exactly as sealed; any change requires a new evaluation.
No answer from the daemon means BLOCK (fail closed).
Do not re-submit a blocked action unchanged, split it to evade checks, or route around the daemon.
Verify proofs presented to you with VerifyProof before relying on them.
certificate_scope: A Guardian Mesh certificate vouches for the exact item tested, against the policy named, on the date stamped — never for deployment choices, configuration, or runtime environment.

components.name: Sentinel
components.role: First check — runs the protocol firewall's 18 message checks over the sealed payload, context, and target.

components.name: Gatekeeper
components.role: Identity and permission — requires a live handshake session and a valid HMAC, else BLOCK.

components.name: Witness
components.role: Signs the record — hashes verdict + reason and signs the digest with ML-DSA-65.

components.name: Arbiter
components.role: Final decision — applies policy; anything undecided defaults to BLOCK.

components.name: Vault
components.role: Seals the proof — tamper-evident envelope (CRC32C + ML-DSA-65) around the signed audit proof.

components.name: Protocol Firewall
components.role: The 18 message checks every request must pass.

flow: seal the action in an HMAC-signed envelope

name: Guardian Mesh

working_today: website and demonstration control panel (sample values, not connected to a daemon)

summary: A guardian system for AI agents and software: every action is evaluated before it runs, and every verdict ships with a signed, independently re-checkable proof.
